148: class Extractor:
149:     """Encapsulates the split-repo vs mono-repo differences."""
150: 
151:     def __init__(self, is_split_repo: bool = True):
152:         self.is_split_repo = is_split_repo
153:         if is_split_repo:
154:             self.path_format = SPLIT_REPO_PATH_FORMAT
155:             self.repos_key = REPO_RESPONSE_KEY
156:         else:
157:             self.path_format = MONO_REPO_PATH_FORMAT
158:             self.repos_key = PACKAGE_RESPONSE_KEY
159: 
160:     def include_repo(self, repo) -> bool:
161:         return not self.is_split_repo or allowed_repo(repo)
162: 
163:     def client_for_repo(self, repo_slug) -> Optional[CloudClient]:
164:         path = self.path_format.format(repo_slug=repo_slug)
165:         url = f"{RAW_CONTENT_BASE_URL}/{path}/{REPO_METADATA_FILENAME}"
166:         response = requests.get(url)
167:         if response.status_code != requests.codes.ok:
168:             return
169: 
170:         return CloudClient(response.json())
171: 
172:     def get_clients_batch_from_response_json(self, response_json) -> List[CloudClient]:
173:         return [
174:             self.client_for_repo(repo[self.repos_key])
175:             for repo in response_json
176:             if self.include_repo(repo)
177:         ]
